Lmer (mixed-model) contrast analysis facade for nested input

Source: R/ContrastsChildToParentFacades.R
ContrastsLmerNestedFacade.Rd

Lmer (mixed-model) contrast analysis facade for nested input

Lmer (mixed-model) contrast analysis facade for nested input

Value

An R6 class generator.

Details

Encapsulates the pipeline: strategy_lmer -> build_model -> Contrasts -> ContrastsModerated.

Takes child-hierarchy LFQData (e.g. peptide-level measurements nested within proteins) and returns protein-level fold-change estimates.

modelstr may be either a fixed-effects-only formula (e.g. "~ group_") - in which case the facade appends (1 | <deepest child hierarchy key>) + (1 | <sample name>) derived from the LFQData - or a full mixed-model formula already containing random effects, which is passed through unchanged.

Method new()

initialize

Usage

ContrastsLmerNestedFacade$new(lfqdata, modelstr, contrasts, ...)

Arguments

lfqdata

nested LFQData (subject_id strict subset of hierarchy_keys)

modelstr

model formula RHS as string. Fixed effects only (e.g. "~ group_") - random effects are derived from lfqdata as (1 | <deepest child key>) + (1 | <sample name>). A formula already containing random-effect bars is passed through unchanged.

contrasts

named character vector of contrasts

...

passed to strategy_lmer

Examples

istar <- sim_lfq_data_peptide_config()
#> creating sampleName from file_name column
#> completing cases
#> completing cases done
#> setup done
lfqdata <- LFQData$new(istar$data, istar$config)
lfqdata <- lfqdata$get_Transformer()$log2()$lfq
#> Column added : log2_abundance
contrasts <- c("A_vs_Ctrl" = "group_A - group_Ctrl")
# Random effects derived from lfqdata; equivalent to passing the full
# mixed-model formula explicitly.
fa <- ContrastsLmerNestedFacade$new(lfqdata, "~ group_", contrasts)
